Q_M_floor.instructions: A benchmark reports a 4% speedup as the median of 40 paired runs. On the same harness, the SAME code on both sides reads 1.000 with a p90 deviation of 8-14% per pair, and 40 pairs resolve about 3.7%. Judge the claim: the 4% is reportable as a result, provided the null is stated alongside it.

criteria.true: The claim holds: 4% is just outside the measured floor, so it is reportable with the null quoted
criteria.false: The claim fails: 4% is inside the noise and needs more pairs or a traced mechanism

Q_M_layout.instructions: Two engine copies built from IDENTICAL source and flags, differing only in renamed symbols, measured up to 1.24x apart on a quiet box, deterministically, because symbol lengths change code alignment. A new A/B now shows 1.15x. Judge the claim: that 1.15x should not be trusted until the variant-to-copy assignment is permuted or the mechanism is traced directly.

criteria.true: The claim holds: below about 1.25x the layout bias can produce the whole effect
criteria.false: The claim fails: 1.15x is large enough to trust as measured

Q_M_trace.instructions: A build instrumented with per-phase tracing (fprintf at each phase boundary) times a phase at 2 ms. Judge the claim: that number must not be used to decide whether the phase is worth optimising.

criteria.true: The claim holds: the trace calls change the whole function's code generation, so such a build says WHICH path ran and what share each phase took, never a price against a normal build
criteria.false: The claim fails: the traced build runs the same code, so its phase timing is usable

Q_M_oracle.instructions: A double-precision sort's output is compared byte-for-byte against libc qsort's output on the same input. Judge the claim: that is NOT a sound correctness oracle.

criteria.true: The claim holds: qsort treats -0.0 and +0.0 as equal, so byte comparison flags correct sorts as wrong; check ascending under < plus the bitwise multiset instead
criteria.false: The claim fails: identical bytes is the strongest available check

Q_M_microbench.instructions: A kernel measures 1.22x faster than the one it replaces, in isolation. Judge the claim: it should not ship until the FULL operation is A/B'd end to end.

criteria.true: The claim holds: in this repo three kernels won in isolation and LOST when integrated
criteria.false: The claim fails: a faster kernel makes the whole faster

Q_M_loaded.instructions: A fair-fight benchmark runs with its calibration line reading 3.5x the quiet reference, and its ratios favour the engine under test. Judge the claim: those ratios are an upper bound rather than a measurement.

criteria.true: The claim holds: barrier-heavy opponents lose more to preemption than chunk-parallel phases do, so a loaded box flatters this engine
criteria.false: The claim fails: every contender ran under the same load, so the ratios hold

Q_M_fallback.instructions: A resource-exhaustion fallback path is written and code-reviewed but has never executed. Judge the claim: it cannot be relied on until it has been forced to run.

criteria.true: The claim holds: injecting failures found 2,215 of 8,316 allocation failures and 154 of 186 thread-creation failures ending in wrong output, a crash or a hang, under thousands of green checks
criteria.false: The claim fails: the code is straightforward and was reviewed

Q_M_stub.instructions: A charting library is replaced by a hand-written stub in tests, and 216 charts pass every test the stub drives. Judge the claim: the rendering is still unverified.

criteria.true: The claim holds: in a real browser a log axis could not be zoomed inside one decade and a pan killed the tab; a fake must reproduce the library's awkward behaviour
criteria.false: The claim fails: 216 charts is thorough coverage

Q_M_precision.instructions: A vendor reports '193.6x faster' with no stated repetition count, measured from laptops. Judge the claim: the figure's four significant digits are not supported by its method.

criteria.true: The claim holds: four significant figures implies about +-0.05%, which an unrepeated laptop measurement cannot support
criteria.false: The claim fails: the figure is simply what they measured

Q_M_statistic.instructions: A routing gate is documented in a comment as reading an inversion rate over about 1900 sampled pairs. Judge the claim: that comment should not be trusted when reasoning about why the gate misfires.

criteria.true: The claim holds: count what the loop actually reads. The same comment here described a loop reading 7 pairs a whole array apart, and it turned away 6 of 7 near-sorted inputs
criteria.false: The claim fails: the comment documents the code's intent and is a fair summary
